# DevFlowAI

> Free, open-source developer toolkit for AI development. 20 browser-based tools. No login, no API keys required. Everything works locally. AI features are optional and free.

- Full documentation: https://devflowai.dev/llms-full.txt

## About

DevFlowAI is a collection of 20 developer productivity tools that run entirely in the browser. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. Designed for developers working with AI/LLM APIs.

- URL: https://devflowai.dev
- Source: https://github.com/albertoguinda/devflow-ai
- License: MIT
- Languages: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Italian, Chinese, Japanese

## Tools

### Prompt Analyzer
Analyze prompt quality, detect injection vulnerabilities, and optimize prompts for LLMs. Scores prompts on clarity, specificity, context, and safety. Generates refined versions using XML-structured prompt engineering techniques.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/prompt-analyzer

### Code Review Assistant
Automated code quality analysis with issue detection, complexity scoring, and refactoring suggestions. Supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, and more.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/code-review

### API Cost Calculator
Compare AI API costs across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and other providers. Input tokens, output tokens, and daily requests to see monthly cost projections with interactive charts.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/cost-calculator

### Token Visualizer
Real-time token counting and visualization for GPT and Claude tokenizers. See how AI models split your text into tokens, identify waste, and optimize prompt efficiency.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/token-visualizer

### Context Manager
Build and optimize LLM context windows. Upload files, organize by priority, track token budgets, and export optimized context in XML or JSON format.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/context-manager

### Regex Humanizer
Explain regular expressions in plain language. Paste any regex to get a detailed breakdown, or describe what you need and get the pattern generated. Includes real-time tester.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/regex-humanizer

### DTO-Matic
Convert JSON API responses to TypeScript interfaces, domain entities, mapper functions, and Zod schemas. Follows Clean Architecture principles.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/dto-matic

### Cron Builder
Visual cron expression builder with human-readable explanations, next execution preview, and common presets.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/cron-builder

### Tailwind Sorter
Sort Tailwind CSS classes by category, remove duplicates, order responsive variants, and preview light/dark mode output.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/tailwind-sorter

### Variable Name Wizard
Generate variable names from descriptions, convert between 8 naming conventions (camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, etc.), and get type-aware suggestions.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/variable-name-wizard

### JSON Formatter
Format, minify, validate JSON. Extract paths, compare documents, generate TypeScript interfaces, and view real-time statistics.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/json-formatter

### HTTP Status Finder
Search and explore HTTP status codes with descriptions, use cases, code snippets, and a decision wizard to find the right status code.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/http-status-finder

### Git Commit Generator
Generate Conventional Commits messages from diffs or descriptions. Supports feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, and chore types with scopes and breaking changes.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/git-commit-generator

### Base64 Encoder/Decoder
Encode and decode Base64 with support for text, files, and images. Includes batch processing, JWT decoding, byte analysis, and hex/binary views.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/base64

### UUID Generator
Generate UUID v1, v3, v4, v5, and v7. Batch generation, namespace support, bit-level inspection, and bulk validation.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/uuid-generator

### Hash Generator
Generate cryptographic hashes (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512) for text and files. Compare hashes, batch processing, and HMAC support.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/hash-generator

### JWT Decoder
Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens. View header, payload, and signature. Validate expiration, check claims, and format output.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/jwt-decoder

### Color Converter
Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSB, and CMYK formats. Color picker, contrast checker, palette generation, and CSS output.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/color-converter

### Diff Comparer
Compare two texts side-by-side with syntax highlighting. Detect additions, deletions, and modifications. Supports unified and split diff views.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/diff-comparer

### Password Generator
Generate secure passwords with customizable length, character sets, and entropy calculation. Passphrase mode, strength meter, and batch generation.
URL: https://devflowai.dev/tools/password-generator

## Technical Stack

- Framework: Next.js 16 with React 19 and React Compiler
- Language: TypeScript 5 (maximum strict mode, zero `any`)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 + HeroUI v3
- AI Backend: 4 providers (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Pollinations)
- Testing: 1780+ unit tests (Vitest), 25 E2E specs (Playwright)
- Accessibility: WCAG AAA compliant, axe-core audited
- Architecture: Clean Architecture with 5-layer pattern per tool
